title: H 4295 (126th General Assembly): Gold Standard Elections Act
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id) not stated.
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship)
(section) Sec. 2 (7-3-20(D)(20))
(quote) utilize the U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services' SAVE services to identify individuals who are not citizens of the United States who are registered to vote in this State. The executive director must remove these individuals from the list of registered voters and shall maintain a separate list of the individuals removed pursuant to this item that shall be publicly available
(section) Sec. 3 (7-5-160)
(quote) A person registering to vote must provide valid identification to confirm his residency and citizenship to the county board of voter registration and elections prior to the completion of the voter registration process. The county board of voter registration and elections must issue a new voter identification card each time a person successfully registers to vote.
(e_other_rule)
(section) Sec. 2 (7-3-20(D)(21))
(quote) compare the voter registration list with the U.S. Postal Service's National Change of Address Program and the U.S. Social Security's Death Index and Master Death File. This comparison must be done on a monthly basis.
(section) Sec. 7 (new 7-13-700)
(quote) Only qualified electors who comply with all constitutional and statutory requirements to vote may be permitted to vote in an election.
(section) Sec. 13 (7-15-320(A))
(quote) Only U.S. citizens with a current and valid voter registration shall be allowed to vote.
(other) Sec. 2 (7-3-20(D)): executive director keeps separate databases of active, inactive and archived registrations and gives voter rolls free to qualified electors.
(other) Sec. 3 (7-5-160): registration lasts ten years (replaces permanent registration).
(other) Sec. 4 (new 7-5-200): paper poll books only.
(other) Sec. 5 (new 7-7-715): precinct size limits; felony for a director who violates.
(other) Sec. 6 (7-13-72): four election managers per 250 voters.
(other) Sec. 8 (7-13-730): ballot must carry initials of two poll managers or is void.
(other) Sec. 9-10 (new 7-13-870, 7-13-880): hand-marked paper ballots counted by hand at the precinct in public view; chain-of-custody records.
(other) Sec. 11-12 (7-13-1110, 7-13-1160): public may watch the count; counties post results before reporting.
(other) Sec. 13 (7-15-320): removes early-voting references, strikes absentee eligibility for people 65 or older, adds women expecting to give birth within three weeks and homebound persons and nursing home occupants.
(other) Sec. 15 (7-15-420(A)): absentee ballots are sorted by precinct, taken to the precinct and counted after polls close; void if the voter also voted in person.
(other) Sec. 16 (53-5-10): general election day a legal holiday.
(other) Sec. 17: effective on approval by the Governor.
(other) Sec. 16 (new 7-19-130): presidential electors chosen by this State must object to, and vote for no candidate in, a federal election process that admits electors from a state using internet-connected voting machines and closed source code.
(other) Sec. 14 (7-15-330(B)(5)): absentee request needs signature of requester and a witness.
(other) version: Only one version (Introduced, 2025-04-03). Same bill as H 3628 of 2025 under the short title 'Gold Standard Elections Act', with two additions: a citizenship check using USCIS SAVE services (slot d, flagged people only are removed) plus monthly list checks against change-of-address and death files (slot e), and the new 7-19-130 electors section.
(other) note: Strike/new markers restored from the HTML styling. The SAVE check is a database check of the whole voter list; people it flags are removed and put on a public list; the bill does not say they may show proof. Only the introduced text is saved.
